description: This Java source file defines the class BlogRssServices, which contains methods to generate RSS feeds for blog content within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes functionality to query content, create feed entries, and assemble the RSS feed, utilizing the Rome library for syndication feed generation.

classes.name: BlogRssServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for generating RSS feeds for blog content within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: generateBlogRssFeed
methods.description: Generates an RSS feed for a specific blog content identified by content ID, assembling feed metadata and entries based on associated content.

methods.name: generateEntryList
methods.description: Creates a list of SyndEntry objects representing individual blog articles linked to the main content, including description, link, and author information.
